$comment: Controlled vocabularies. Every value used in venues.json must exist here. Order matters: `topics` renders left-to-right in the topic filter row, `paperStages` renders left-to-right in the progress bar.

narrowTopics.$comment: Finer-grained topics a user may put in their own paper profile, mapped to the broad topic they roll up into. A paper tagged `fairness` matches a venue tagged `trustworthy AI`. Keys are NOT valid venue topics; values must be.

rankingSources.$comment: displayed=false keeps a ranking in the data but out of the UI. MNiSW is collected and hidden by product decision.
